FIELDS.NAME: Strategic Insights Consulting
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: At Strategic Insights Consulting, we specialize in providing comprehensive business and management consulting services to a diverse range of clients. Our core operations focus on strategic planning, operational efficiency, and organizational development, aimed at enhancing our clients' competitiveness and overall performance. We engage with businesses to identify opportunities for growth, streamline processes, and implement best practices tailored to their unique needs. Our team of experienced consultants leverages data-driven insights and innovative solutions to support effective decision-making. We operate from a fully remote environment, ensuring minimal physical exposure while upholding high standards of cybersecurity to protect sensitive client information. Our commitment to transparency and accountability is reflected in our professionally drafted client contracts that limit liability and define dispute resolution processes.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On March 10, 2023, Strategic Insights Consulting experienced a data breach resulting from a phishing attack, leading to unauthorized access to sensitive client information. The breach was mitigated quickly, and all affected clients were notified. The total financial impact of the breach was estimated at $15,000, encompassing costs for immediate response actions, legal counsel, and cybersecurity enhancements. The status of this incident is resolved, with measures implemented to prevent future occurrences.
FIELDS.HOURS OF OPERATION: Monday to Friday, 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM
FIELDS.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Class A, Grade 1, Secure Storage Vault
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: Central Station Alarm System with Video Surveillance
